product_summary: Website bolas.co.in (brand 'Bolas') presents itself as: 'Handpicked Dryfruits and Nuts from the best farms in 25+ countries. Processed in our factory and delivered fresh to you with Factory...' (snippet from Bing index of bolas.co.in). Site navigation (read directly from bolas.co.in) lists the actual product lines: 'Nuts & Seeds', 'Dates & Dryfruits', 'Gourmet Snacking', 'Sweets', 'Gifting', 'Oils', 'Premium Pantry'. So the real assortment is dried fruit, nuts, seeds, dates, edible oils, sweets/confectionery and gourmet pantry foods. No coffee or tea line appears anywhere in the site navigation or in the indexed description. Note: the site is JS-rendered — /pages/about-us and /collections/all returned only the navigation menu, so individual SKUs and any HS-relevant detail (roasted vs raw nuts, salted/prepared, retail packs) could not be read. The identity link between the legal entity 'BOLAS AGRO PRIVATE LIMITED' and the bolas.co.in brand is inferred from the identical distinctive trade name only; no page on the site was readable that states the legal entity name, so this is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'.
role_hint: unknown — site describes own factory processing ('Processed in our factory'), which points to manufacturer_trader (imports raw dryfruit from 25+ countries, processes and sells domestically), but no readable page confirms the legal entity, plant or import/export activity. Trader signs: sourcing from 25+ countries and a broad multi-category retail/gifting catalogue (nuts, dates, sweets, oils, pantry) is typical of an importer-repacker rather than a primary producer.
comment: HS mismatch, company retained per Rule 3 — verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Declared 090111 (coffee, not roasted, not decaffeinated), 090210 (green tea in packings ≤3 kg) and 090220 (green tea, other) are all Chapter 9 beverage codes and are NOT supported by anything on the company's own site: the catalogue is dryfruit/nuts/seeds/dates/oils/sweets, i.e. Chapters 8, 12, 15, 17, 18, 20 and 21. Industry label 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is broadly correct but the HS declaration is misclassified at the product-line level — it looks like a copy of a coffee/tea trader's declaration. Corrected actual range: 0802 (nuts), 0804 (dates/dried fruit), 0806.20 (raisins), 0813 (dried fruit mixes), 1202/1207 (seeds), 1515 (vegetable oils), 1704/1806/2008 (sweets, chocolate, prepared nuts), 2106 (food preparations). Product lines missing from the declaration: nuts, dates, raisins, seeds, edible oils, confectionery/sweets, gourmet snacking and gifting hampers — i.e. essentially the entire real assortment. All of the above is 'заявлено, не подтверждено': it rests on the company's own website navigation and marketing text, not on any customs line, B/L or GST record — no shipment or invoice record was consulted or found in this pass. No revenue, volume, CIN or PAN data collected (out of scope for this role); fields left null. Sources: https://bolas.co.in (navigation read directly), Bing index snippet of bolas.co.in ('Handpicked Dryfruits and Nuts from the best farms in 25+ countries. Processed in our factory...'). Search backend (DuckDuckGo/searx) was down and Google returned HTTP 429, so no independent third-party catalogue or IndiaMART page could be checked — coverage of this company is therefore partial and should be re-verified when search is available.
